New report — Decentralised Finance: Mapping Yield, Risk, and Institutional Participation

Institutional interest in DeFi has moved past the question of appetite. What's still catching up are the frameworks to evaluate it properly. Our latest report, produced in partnership with Zodia Custody, applies a traditional finance lens to DeFi — mapping where returns actually come from, the risks behind them, and what institutional-grade participation requires in practice.

Download the report to discover:

🔹 The five sources of DeFi yield, and why headline APY hides more than it reveals
🔹 A risk framework covering financial, smart contract, structural, and stablecoin risk
🔹 Why institutional participation is now constrained by infrastructure, not appetite
🔹 How custody evolves from passive safekeeping to an active control layer in DeFi
🔹 What role asset managers, custodians, and infrastructure providers each play in institutional-grade access

Download the full report via the link.

New report — A Framework for Decomposing DeFi Risk in the Age of AI

As DeFi matures and institutional capital arrives, a common language for measuring and comparing risk is becoming essential. Re7 Capital and Clear Street have jointly published a new report that proposes a framework towards an industry-wide DeFi risk standard, drawing on Re7’s risk methodology.

The report covers:

🔹 Why we propose breaking DeFi risk down into three layers (chain, protocol, and asset), and how a proposed industry standard could be governed
🔹 How risks across layers can compound rather than add up, and what genuine diversification requires across the DeFi stack
🔹 Chain risk and the “1% problem”: how systematic chain selection can help manage infrastructure risk
🔹 How AI is changing the DeFi risk landscape, and how it can enable continuous monitoring across the DeFi stack

Download the full report via the link 👇
